query: UNWIND [1,2] AS x CALL { WITH x CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:x}) } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROWS CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:100+x}) RETURN 1/$d AS z
PROFILE UNWIND [1,2] AS x CALL { WITH x CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:x}) } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROWS CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:100+x}) RETURN 1/$d AS z
UNWIND [1,2] AS x CALL { WITH x CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:x}) } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROWS WITH count(*) AS c SKIP $bad RETURN c

UNWIND [1,2] AS x CALL { WITH x CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:x}) } IN TRANSACTIONS OF 1 ROWS WITH count(*) AS c CALL { CREATE (:ReviewBatch {v:9}) } IN TRANSACTIONS OF head(tail(['bad','bad'])) ROWS
